caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object, which is brown and appears to be made of iron, with a rusted and weathered texture. The object has a hooked, angular shape with a pointed end at the top and a flat edge below the point, resembling a type of industrial hook or tool. A large, oval-shaped metal ring is attached through a loop at the lower end of the object, while another, smaller rounded loop is present midway along its length. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there is a signature in the lower right corner that reads "Herman E. Streel 1940." The object is oriented diagonally on the paper, casting a faint shadow to the right side.
title: Sled Starting Hook
